sentences.en: Through discipline, children are able to learn self-control, self-direction, competence, and a sense of caring.

sentences.en: Children of authoritative parents demonstrate more self-control, higher self-esteem, and a higher level of self-direction.

sentences.en: Applicants must demonstrate a readiness to engage in advanced study by showcasing above-average written communications skills, articulating well-developed academic goals, and showing evidence of self-direction and previous academic success.

sentences.en: It required a lot of self-direction and motivation .

sentences.en: This leads us to the concept of self-direction, so vital to the creative personality.
